name: Alba Iulia

climate.koppen_name: Cold, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Seasons this cool ripen Gewürztraminer, Sauvignon Blanc, Müller-Thurgau, Pinot Gris and Riesling fully without cooking off their freshness.
Sauvignon Blanc and Gewürztraminer sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.
Most rain falls while the vines grow. Damp leaves invite mildew and rot, so growers spray more and pick carefully.

soil.rock: Sandstone is sand bound into rock. It weathers to light, sandy soil that drains freely.
soil.top: The topsoil stores water through dry spells, but stays wet and cold after rain, which slows ripening and can swell the grapes. Its pH is close to neutral, so vines take up the nutrients they need easily.

land: The high ground runs about 7°F cooler than the low ground. Higher vineyards ripen later and keep more acidity, so one grape can make lighter or richer wine here depending on height.
Much of it is steep. Cold air and rain run off, so frost and waterlogging are rare and soils stay thin, keeping yields low. Steep rows are slow and costly to work, often by hand.

winkler: Only very early grapes ripen well, mostly hybrids and a few vinifera.
